hero_kpi_rationale: TotalEnergies is investing heavily in the energy transition, particularly in renewables and electricity, which is a key driver of its future strategy.

kpis.signal: Stable investment in the energy transition.
Gross margin slightly down, impacted by energy prices.
Operating margin down, reflecting market conditions.
Stable R&D investment focused on energy innovation and transition.
Stable headcount with approximately 102,579 employees across 120 countries.
Dividend per share of EUR 0.85 last year.

tagline: A global integrated energy company producing and marketing oil, natural gas, renewables and electricity
